correctness.rationale: Each orientation is a three-letter column word containing both singleton letter types. Inclusion–exclusion produces the explicit multiplier (-1)^(n-a)3^a+(-1)^(|u|+|v|)-2^n(1_{u=0}(-1)^|v|+1_{v=0}(-1)^|u|). Nonaxial zeros occur exactly at a=0 with odd count of (1,1) frequency positions; axial vanish impossible for n≥3 by 3^a modulo8 versus 2^n−1. There are (3^n−1)/2 zeros. Evenness of |S| and an explicit nonaxial character attain gap2. n=2 separately gives two support words and eight zeros; n=1 empty support. Direct FWHT n=1..5 gives zeros 4,8,13,40,121, confirming boundary and formula.
